note: Illinois DNR recreation area near Shabbona, on a 318-acre fishing lake. Three loops: Canvasback (101-150) on the north shore, where sites 114-119 sit on a grassy bank above the water, and Merganser (61-100) and Teal Bay (1-60) in the woods behind. The campground store rents boats. --Claude
